text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
While wondering what to get from the 
cafeteria's lunch menu, I ran into 
Nakayama Festa.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
From the look of it, you're also having 
trouble deciding what to eat?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Yay! Hey, you two lost souls over there! 
How about a mythical one-plate lunch, 
produced by Golshi-chan☆?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: "...Oh? What makes it an illusion?"

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
It's so rare, they might only make one 
serving a day! And it's right up 
Nakayama's alley! You wanna know what it 
is, right? Alright, listen up!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
I had a hand-picked team come up with the 
menu! And believe it or not, the one in 
charge of the main dish is—

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: It's Meisho Doto!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Wh-what...?!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Doto, who has a reputation as one of the 
biggest spice lovers in the academy... is 
doing this?!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
...Hahaha, I can already picture a plate 
covered in red!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
And handling the side menu, Satono 
Diamond!!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Ah, that young lady who defies common 
sense purely out of curiosity...! Heheh... 
what kind of concoction is she going to 
brew up?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Agnes Tachyon's the one in charge of 
dessert, dang it!!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, whoa, whoa, is that really dessert?! 
You're just masking something lethal with 
insane sweetness, aren't you?!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: —And! General Supervisor: Oguri Cap!!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
...H-Haha, did they really just serve up a 
crazy menu in massive portions...?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Kuhahahahaha! —You've got yourself a bet!!
choice_data_list:
Calm down! That is definitely not a normal 
amount!
If we're doing this, we finish every bite!

If we take on the challenge, we're 
finishing every bite!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Kuhahahahaha! —You've got yourself a bet!!
choice_data_list:

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"It was an extraordinary amount, so I 
desperately tried to convince them, 
warning that if they couldn't finish it, 
nobody else would be able to eat it for 
them."

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
—...Tch, fine. Wasting food is a sin. I'll 
just get something from the normal menu.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Tch... Next time, I'll have to aim for a 
moment when the Trainer isn't around...

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Hell yeahhh! One Phantom order! Make it an 
Oguri-sized serving!!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Heheheh... Will you finish every bite, 
pass out in agony, or will your gut burst 
first...? Man, this gives me the chills!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, Nakayama Festa took on an absurdly 
huge portion of food and cleaned her 
plate. Apparently, the taste was perfectly 
respectable.
